biteOfDay: ing Trout fishing on Lake Taneycomo has improved noticeably over the last month. Good numbers of rainbows are showing throughout the upper lake compared to summer, and brown trout are making a strong fall spawning appearance, especially in the first mile of wadeable water below the dam. Anglers are finding them on scuds, small streamers, midges, and marabou jigs. Night fishing remains popular with

tableRock.clarity: Gin-clear near dam; verify arms locally

taneycomo.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.
taneycomo.generation: ~7,775,295 cfs at 12:00 CT (USACE live). Overnight ~20; afternoon peak ~7,775,295. Call SWPA 866-494-1993 before you wad.

tip: Insider tip: Take advantage of the low early-morning flows on Taneycomo. Wade or drift seams and current breaks with a 1/16- to 1/8-oz marabou micro jig (black, sculpin, olive, or with an Indy orange head), zebra midge (#14–20 in red or black), or scud.
